propositions: Tool-call loops in the completion gate's verify step exhaust the step budget, surface a bare LLMError with diagnostic: null, and offer only --force-close as a landing option
The existing repetition detector uses an inverted headline metric that fails to distinguish k-cycles from healthy breadth on real traces
Emptying the advertised tool surface mid-run after tool calls have occurred causes Bedrock/Anthropic 400 errors due to missing toolConfig when history contains toolUse blocks
Budget exhaustions and runaway loops lack operator-actionable diagnostics that discriminate between looping and out-of-space conditions
High-breadth runs with healthy distinct ratios (>0.833 in 24-window) are sometimes incorrectly truncated by budget enforcement mechanisms
Request and tool-call usage is not recorded durably by default, preventing post-hoc gate tuning and loop-vs-breadth analysis
